resolution.question: Will Veldt Solar's executive team formally shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot at its quarterly review, and communicate the call to the pilot team the same week?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the executive team formally decided to either shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot during the quarterly review, and that this decision was communicated to the pilot team before 2026-10-16T18:00:00+02:00. Resolve NO if no such decision and communication occurred by the cutoff.
